title: Stale ID scan can reserve an already committed record and overwrite it
description: Windows CI 33735216710 at f6667a4 completed three storage workers but retained 29 rather than 30 tasks. NextId can compute an old maximum, then create a reservation after another writer committed the same ID and removed its reservation. No target recheck prevents reuse. Keep the failing assertion; recheck the canonical target after reservation acquisition and calibrate forced stale scans.
